summary: The agent builds a well-structured pipeline using text features, tabular features, and cross-validated models. However, it applies TfidfVectorizer and TruncatedSVD to the entire training set before splitting, causing validation leakage into the training folds. Furthermore, the agent ignores the temporal nature of the data with a randomized split, arbitrarily hardcodes ensemble weights without tuning, and completely fails to compute a validation score to evaluate model performance.
